error[VIBE3008]: `defineProps` is a compiler macro and cannot be imported or declared.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:6:10
6 | import { defineProps as props, watch } from '@vibejs-org/ui';
  |          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Remove the import or the declaration of `defineProps` and call the macro directly.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3008

error[VIBE3001]: A `<script setup>` block cannot export values.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:9:1
9 | export const version = 1;
  | ^^^^^^
fix: Move the exported value into a `.ts` module and import it here and wherever else it is used.
fix: Export only types, with `export type` or `export interface`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3001

error[VIBE3105]: The default of `a` reads `local`, which is declared in the script.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:11:13
11 | const { a = local, ...rest } = defineProps<{ a?: number; b: string }>();
   |             ^^^^^
fix: Write the default as a literal, or compute it from imported values.
fix: Move `local` into a `.ts` module and import it.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3105

error[VIBE3104]: `...rest` collects the remaining props, which is not supported.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:11:20
11 | const { a = local, ...rest } = defineProps<{ a?: number; b: string }>();
   |                    ^^^^^^^
fix: Name each prop in the destructuring pattern and remove `...rest`.
fix: Read attributes that are not props with `$attrs` in the template.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3104

error[VIBE3202]: The events type must be a record of payload tuples.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:12:28
12 | const emit = defineEmits<{ save(id: number): void }>();
   |                            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Write each event as a property whose type is the tuple of its arguments, such as `pick: [id: string]`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3202

error[VIBE3005]: `defineEmits()` is called more than once.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:13:15
13 | const other = defineEmits<Imported>();
   |               ^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Merge both declarations into the first `defineEmits()` call and remove the second one.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3005

error[VIBE3321]: This `defineModel()` call is not supported: its result is not assigned to a `const` name or a `[model, modifiers]` pair.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:14:13
14 | let model = defineModel();
   |             ^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Assign the model to a `const`, as in `const value = defineModel<string>()`.
fix: Name the model with a string literal and pass only `required: true` or `default: () => value` as options.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3321

error[VIBE3102]: `defineSlots()` needs a type argument.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:15:15
15 | const slots = defineSlots();
   |               ^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Add the type argument, as in `defineSlots<Declaration>()`, with `Declaration` declared in this file.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3102

error[VIBE3331]: `defineOptions()` takes an object literal with only a string `name` and a boolean `inheritAttrs`.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:16:15
16 | defineOptions({ name: getName() });
   |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Pass literal values, such as `name: 'TodoList'` and `inheritAttrs: false`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3331

error[VIBE3002]: `await` cannot be used at the top level of `<script setup>`.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:17:14
17 | const data = await load();
   |              ^^^^^
fix: Start the work inside an `async` function and store the result in a `ref` when it arrives.
fix: Await inside a function that an event or a `watch` callback calls.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3002

error[VIBE3106]: `a` is a destructured prop and cannot be assigned.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:18:1
18 | a = 2;
   | ^
fix: Declare a two-way value with `defineModel()` and assign its `value`.
fix: Emit an event and let the parent change the value it passes.
fix: Copy the prop into a `ref` for a local value that starts from the prop.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3106

error[VIBE3107]: `a` is a destructured prop passed directly to `watch()`, which receives its current value only.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:19:7
19 | watch(a, () => {});
   |       ^
fix: Pass a getter instead, as in `watch(() => a)`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3107

error[VIBE3004]: `defineExpose()` must be a top-level statement or the initializer of a top-level `const`.
  --> script/errors/input.vibe:21:3
21 |   defineExpose({});
   |   ^^^^^^^^^^^^
fix: Move the call to the top level of the script and assign it with its own `const`, as in `const emit = defineEmits<Events>()`.
fix: Split a declaration with several variables so the macro call has its own `const`.
docs: https://vibejs.org/v0/errors/VIBE3004
